At its selected **k = 20**, Llama 3.1 8B→70B transfer reaches **57.78% MMLU** and **14.78% GSM8K** (Table 13, p. 18).

| Benchmark | Transfer (8B→70B) | 70B standalone | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|
| MMLU (5-shot) | 57.78 | 78.84 | 73.3% |
| GSM8K (8-shot CoT) | 14.78 | 81.12 | 18.2% |

- The absolute accuracies and the 70B standalone baseline come from Table 13 (p. 18).
- The retention figures and k = 20 come from Table 1 (p. 6). Table 12 (p. 17) also lists k = 20 for this pair.
- Floor-normalized retention is 60.9 on MMLU and 18.2 on GSM8K (Table 15, p. 18).
